opening.argument: The central presentation is a bullish forecast of how Strategy could reach one million Bitcoin, including a model that ties common-stock issuance to additional purchases at the stated Bitcoin price. The speaker also acknowledges that part of the model is difficult to predict. Horizon’s sponsor segment asks homeowners to visit its site and explore converting a portion of home equity into Bitcoin. That is a financial-product promotion alongside market commentary, but the cited material does not establish a deceptive request for money or data. The invitation to explore an estimate does not, on its own, establish what happens afterward.
